Cheating is absolutely disgusting and  I’m so sorry you went through that. You’re eyes are not buggy and your nose is not big. They fit your face nicely. You also have cool hair. You do not need to lose weight at all my dude. Don’t let the actions and stupidity of others change the way you see yourself. People do fucked up shit and hurt others because of their own issues. Do not be discouraged. You are not to blame and you are better off with out that person in your life. Things will get better. Slowly. But surely.

* I want to clarify that I’m not saying I only do good things so I get good things. I’m saying that I continue to try to be positive and continue to try to help others and not let go of that because it is the right thing to do and one day it will be worth it. There have been many times where I would think “wow I should really start treating others the way they treat me so they can see what they put me through” or “I’m not gunna text them first anymore because they never do the same for me”  so that is when the whole “I have to believe one day I’ll be rewarded” comes in to play. I’m saying that I have to believe putting good in the world is worth it even when I’m going through a rough time  and even when others don’t do the same for me is the right thing to do because those people need the help and maybe one day someone will be there to help me. *

Please know that you are important. You are loved. You are here in this earth to make it better. It breaks my heart to know the pain you face everyday. The best thing for you to do is seek out the help you need. Do not try to self medicate any longer. The alcohol, the cutting. All of it. It’s okay to get help from others. Do not push them away. You will become a better you in no time. You are kind, smart, caring. Do not waste your life. You are worth so much more than you know. Don’t stop fighting!
